data_objects.name: trajectory_poi_visits
data_objects.meaning: User trajectory records at points of interest, with trajectory and place identifiers, visit timing, photo count, trajectory length, and point-of-interest duration.

variables.name: userID
variables.meaning: Identifier for the user associated with the trajectory.

variables.name: trajID
variables.meaning: Identifier for a trajectory associated with the user.

variables.name: poiID
variables.meaning: Identifier for the point of interest visited within the trajectory.

variables.name: startTime
variables.meaning: Integer start timestamp for the point-of-interest visit, consistent with epoch-style seconds.

variables.name: endTime
variables.meaning: Integer end timestamp for the point-of-interest visit, consistent with epoch-style seconds.

variables.name: #photo
variables.meaning: Number of photos associated with the point-of-interest visit.

variables.name: trajLen
variables.meaning: Length of the trajectory expressed as a number of point-of-interest records.

variables.name: poiDuration
variables.meaning: Duration of the point-of-interest visit, corresponding to the elapsed start-to-end timestamp interval.

structure.description: Each row represents one user's visit to one point of interest within a trajectory.
userID and trajID identify the trajectory context, while multiple poiID records can belong to that trajectory.
startTime and endTime bound the visit interval represented by poiDuration.

uncertainties: The epoch, timezone, point-of-interest catalog, and ordering convention for records within a trajectory are not explicitly stated.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the identifiers, timestamp relationships, and labels visible in train.csv.
